The 43-credit general-education selection shares BIOL 102 and PSYC 101 with major foundations. Its unique allocation is 37 credits, plus 12 foundations, 39 major courses and 32 free electives, totaling 120.
All four religion courses with conditional transfer waivers remain in this baseline.
RLGN 105 and EVAN 101 may be waived for at least 45 undergraduate transfer credits; individual university evaluation is required.
THEO 201 and THEO 202 may also be waived for at least 60 undergraduate transfer credits; individual university evaluation is required.

The reviewed baseline selects 60 credits in exact campus receiving awards and 60 credits at Liberty. Its 51-credit major retains 27 institutional credits; 39 required upper-level major credits remain counted at their receiving level.

Five free electives propose distinct unused residential PSYC 305, 306, 307, 308 and 309 courses. PSYC 305 is completed before PSYC 307, 308 and 309; PSYC 101 and 255 are already required. These are optional named baseline choices within the published unrestricted free-elective block.

PSYC 497 is the published fixed 3-credit Special Topics in Psychology course, with PSYC 101/255 chosen from its documented prerequisite alternatives. Actual section availability remains an individual registration step.
